Beau Maverick shakes the whole state of Texas to its roots with the startling announcement of his intention to marry.

A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

After the death of a rich and very distant cousin, bumbling cowboy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) convinces his pal Billy (Buster Crabbe) to travel with him to the dead man's estate to try to claim the fortune. When they arrive, they meet Helen Stockton (Lorraine Miller), the rightful heir to the estate, but the cousin's scheming superintendent wants the inheritance for himself, so he sends his henchmen after Fuzzy, Billy and Helen. The trio must thwart the crooks and vie for the money.

Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez).
Green Flake, an enslaved pioneer and member of the Latter-day Saints, embarks on a courageous cross-country journey that becomes integral to the Mormon migration and the settlement of Utah.
With his days winding down, an aging gunman sets out on a quest to perform one last good deed, hoping to save his soul.

Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).
A widow reveals the whereabouts of hidden gold.
Cheyenne and Smitty agree to lead a wagon train.
Kitty Angel (Anne Baxter) and her adopted child are abandoned by the train.
Flint (Robert Horton) prepares for a duel with a former associate (Everett Sloane) who had disillusioned him during the Civil War.
A former governor of a Mexican province seeks U.S. refuge.
The marshal is forced to do some fast shooting when he squares off with a gang of swindlers.
A runaway soldier and a beautiful dance-hall singer give Troop trouble.
The marshal gets in the middle of a fight between troublesome buffalo hunters and Indians on the warpath.
Randall becomes a father at the same time that his buddy James has his 17th child. The men begin an eccentric style of counseling to help them in their relationships.

Miguel (Javier Bardem), a Spanish doctor, puts himself in harm's way to deliver medical treatment to the victims of military uprisings. Wren (Charlize Theron) is the spokesperson for an organization that funds medical assistance for impoverished nations the world over. They meet in Liberia, where Wren is immediately impressed with Miguel's selflessness, medical skill and charm. They begin a torrid affair, one they must learn to balance with their important work.
Unique and his soldiers assume control of the corners in Queens, leaving Raq and Marvin in desperate need of more answers and more product; Kanan searches for a missing O-Cee.
Raq goes on the offensive as Marvin and Lou attempt to contain the escalating situations; Jukebox joins the search for O-Cee, while Kanan looks into his theory on what happened to Famous.

Starr Carter is constantly switching between two worlds -- the poor, mostly black neighborhood where she lives and the wealthy, mostly white prep school that she attends. The uneasy balance between these worlds is soon shattered when she witnesses the fatal shooting of her childhood best friend at the hands of a police officer. Facing pressure from all sides of the community, Starr must find her voice and decide to stand up for what's right.

For Victor Rosa (John Leguizamo), that blunt world-view has come to define his life. A Latino hustler from the South Bronx, Victor has worked his way up the neighborhood ladder to become a crew leader for Joanna La Colombiana Menéndez (Isabella Rossellini). But after narrowly escaping an attempt on his life, Victor realizes that he needs to get out of the Bronx, both for himself and for his girlfriend, Carmen (Sônia Braga), the only thing more important to him than money.
The long arm of their criminal past makes it difficult for two brothers (Avelawance Phillips, Malik Barnhardt) to create new lives for themselves and those they love.
Three virginal buddies (Marc 7, Saafir, Mr. Short Khop) go on a quest for their first sexual encounter.

p.t: Fred 2: Night of the Living Fred

p.d: A teen tries to save a friendly robot from a ruthless CEO who wants to turn it into a dangerous weapon.
A lonely girl tries to protect a valuable white lion cub from the poachers who kidnapped it and will stop at nothing to get it back.
A widowed chef (Steve Lemme) and his daughter (Rylie Behr) move to Chicago, but a clause in their new apartment's rental agreement means that they will have to give up their beloved dog.
After the trolls' victory over the Snow Queen, Orm claims that he is destined to marry the princess and inherit great power.
A science experiment turns a boy's (Matthew Knight) dog into a human (Ryan Belleville).

When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child, but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15-year-old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

Framed for a murder he did not commit, three-time speedway champ Jensen Ames (Jason Statham) finds himself at Terminal Island, the country's toughest prison, but he gets an unexpected chance at freedom when the warden offers a choice: Compete in the Death Race as a mythical driver called Frankenstein, or rot in a cell forever. Riding in a car equipped with flamethrowers and grenade launchers, Ames must survive a gauntlet of vicious criminals to win his freedom -- or die trying.

The people of Detroit know 8 Mile as the city limit, a border, a boundary. It is also a psychological dividing line that separates Jimmy Smith Jr. (Eminem) from where and who he wants to be. A provocative fictional examination of a critical week in Jimmy's life.

As adopted brothers Stone and Reach prepare for the biggest and most dangerous heist of their lives, they find themselves caught in a high-stakes game of survival. A relentless foreign mafia, seeking to settle scores, hunts them down, while unresolved family tensions from their past threaten to unravel their plans. Meanwhile, a determined police force is closing in, intent on bringing them to justice, turning their ambitious job into a race against time.

Texas Ranger Roland Sharp (Tommy Lee Jones) follows a strict code of behavior and has no patience for those who don't follow suit. When five cheerleaders -- Anne (Christina Milian), Teresa (Paula Garcés), Evie (Monica Keena), Heather (Vanessa Ferlito) and Barb (Kelli Garner) -- witness a murder, Sharp is assigned to keep them from meeting the same fate. But his assignment requires him to go undercover as their coach and live in their house, and so, some ground rules are in order.

When the actions of Jason Bourne spark a fire that threatens to burn down decades of research across a number of secret intelligence agencies, Eric Byer (Edward Norton), the man who built the programs, decides he must sacrifice one of them: Outcome. Aaron Cross (Jeremy Renner), one of Outcome's six agents, and research scientist Marta Shearing (Rachel Weisz) go on the run when Byer targets them for termination. But Cross proves to be a far deadlier target than Byer realizes.

Serie de películas que muestra lo que ocurre detrás de escena en los últimos estrenos, entre los que se incluyen "La Gran Muralla", "LEGO Batman Película" y "¡Huye!".
El excampeón del mundo de peso pesado Rocky Balboa se desempeña como el entrenador y mentor de Adonis Johnson, el hijo de su difunto amigo y antiguo rival Apollo Creed.
Supervisado por el legendario Rocky Balboa, el espectacular púgil Adonis Johnson se prepara para un combate contra el hijo de Iván Drago, el boxeador soviético que mató a Apollo Creed en el ring.

Adonis Creed, aún dominando el mundo del boxeo, prospera en su carrera y en su vida familiar, pero un amigo de la infancia y antiguo prodigio del boxeo reaparece tras salir de la cárcel y está ansioso por demostrar que merece otra oportunidad.
Mientras investiga sobre la muerte de su compañero, un detective descubre la corrupción policíaca y un peligroso secreto acerca de una joven.
Aquaman debe recuperar el legendario Tridente de Atlan para salvar a la ciudad subacuática de Atlantis, y al mundo de la superficie, de su hermano hambriento de poder.

Unos científicos que investigan el océano liberan accidentalmente a un megalodón, un tiburón prehistórico gigante que se creía extinto hace millones de años. Ahora deberán arriesgar sus vidas para evitar una masacre en las costas del Pacífico.

Fin and his wife April travel around the world to save their young son who's trapped inside a Sharknado.
The leader of a wagon train across the New Mexico territory in 1847 comes across a highway.
A man recovering from a nervous breakdown sees a horrifying creature on the wing of his plane. With William Shatner.
A man (John McGiver) who enjoys loud noises is driven crazy when trivial sounds become deafening to him.
Fleeing from a World War I aerial battle, a pilot gets lost in both space and time.
The manager of a baseball team on a losing streak hires a robot pitcher called Casey.

A high-end art thief becomes trapped inside a luxury, high-tech penthouse in New York's Times Square after his heist doesn't go as planned. Locked inside with nothing but priceless works of art, he must use all his cunning and invention to survive.

CIA agent Mason "Mace" Brown joins forces with a rival German agent, a cutting-edge computer specialist and a Colombian psychologist when a top-secret weapon falls into the hands of a group of mercenaries. Together, the four women embark on a breakneck mission to save the world while staying one step ahead of a mysterious figure who's tracking their every move.

Using his love for comics as inspiration, teenager Dave Lizewski (Aaron Johnson) decides to reinvent himself as a superhero -- despite a complete lack of special powers. Dave dons a costume, dubs himself "Kick-Ass," and gets to work fighting crime. He joins forces with the father/daughter vigilante team of Big Daddy and Hit Girl, then befriends another fledgling crime-fighter called Red Mist (Christopher Mintz-Plasse), but a scheming mobster soon puts their alliance to the test.

In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

Join Duncan Barkes live on Talk.
After a lifetime on Fleet Street, journalist Kevin O'Sullivan tackles some of the biggest stories of the day and champions free speech while leading the culture war against 'woke'.
Westminster insider, author and broadcast presenter Peter Cardwell scours all the latest news from inside and around Parliament, featuring exclusive interviews with political heavyweights.
Late Nights on TALK.
All the best bits from your favourite presenters on TALK.
Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

Jamie's Thai red chicken & squash traybake uses clever tips to get more for your money, a sardine puttanesca proves budget doesn't mean basic, a bagel recipe creates a low-cost lunch and his cherry chocolate mousse is a little bit of low-cost luxury.

From a cosy chicken hotpot with braised cabbage to cheesy French-toast crumpets with smashed peas and bacon, a quick, aromatic fish curry, and a golden pear & almond cake with orange drizzle, Jamie proves simple ingredients really can shine.

Jamie wraps up the series with a gnarly celeriac skewer & flatbread feast, a hearty spiced cauliflower bake complete with edible lid, a steaming winter chilli that's good for your health and for your wallet and two delicious ways to elevate lunch.

From crispy, herby Caprese chicken burgers to golden spinach pies, creamy pork & fennel ragù with fresh pappardelle, and a comforting tinned peach cobbler with fruit-rippled cream, Jamie proves budget-friendly cooking can be utterly delicious.
Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

Un misterioso hombre llega a una ciudad y sin motivo aparente agrede a Claudio, un exitoso abogado. Tras un intento fallido, los ataques continúan, lo que despierta la ira de la esposa de Claudio.
Una mujer (Pilar López de Ayala), que acaba de sufrir un rompimiento doloroso, y un diseñador (Javier Drolas) web fóbico viven en el mismo vecindario pero sufren de la soledad urbana.

El ídolo del cine Don Lockwood pensaba que lo tenía todo en la vida: fama, fortuna y éxito hasta que conoce a la aspirante a actriz Kathy Selden. La joven y la llegada del cine sonoro revolucionarán la vida de Don.

Basado en la obra de William Shakespeare. Intriga política y traición terminan en asesinato en antigua Roma.
Un aristócrata oficial romano se gana el desprecio de Nerón cuando se enamora de una joven cristiana.
Argentina, década de 1970. El padre de Ariel marchó a luchar en la guerra de Yom Kippur y nunca regresó, aunque él no sabe por qué. Ariel sueña con obtener un pasaporte polaco y emigrar a Europa.

Verónica finalmente llega al club y al entrevistar a Rivero presiente que esconde algo. Federico le advierte que se está arriesgando demasiado y sugiere dejar todo en manos de la Justicia. Peque no sale del shock y Rafa investiga.

Verónica toma una decisión arriesgada mientras los hombres de Juan García buscan eliminar cabos sueltos. Lucio no es ajeno al peligro y mantiene a su familia lejos de la ciudad. A su vez, Dientes tiene una idea para terminar con las competencias.
A Nazi spy tries to steal a top-secret Navy thermostat on the West Coast.

Once a private detective, Chandler (Warren Oates) is now working a lowly job as a security guard. That is, until he gets more of a chance to prove himself as an investigator after he's hired to follow and protect Katherine Creighton (Leslie Caron), a government witness who has a band of gangsters after her. While trying to fend off these criminals, Chandler falls for the woman and attempts to keep his head above water in an underworld that might be too dangerous for an aging private eye.

Three passengers aboard an ocean liner reminisce about past loves. In "The Jealous Lover," an acclaimed ballet choreographer (James Mason) remembers his tragic relationship with a talented young ballerina (Moira Shearer). In "Mademoiselle," a young boy is magically transformed into a grown-up (Farley Granger) who then sparks a romance with his governess (Leslie Caron). The final story, "Equilibrium," features a trapeze artist (Kirk Douglas) asks a suicidal woman (Pier Angeli) to join his death-defying act.

In this adaptation of the play "Waterloo Bridge," Gaby (Leslie Caron) is an elegant French ballerina who is performing in World War II-era London. There, a chance encounter introduces her to Gregory Wendell (John Kerr), a passionate young soldier. Gaby warms to him over their day together, and the two besotted young lovers agree to marry as soon as Gregory returns from service. But when Gaby discovers that her fiancé has died in battle, she hopelessly turns to prostitution.

In a retelling of the "Cinderella" tale, young orphan Ella (Leslie Caron) lives with her unpleasant stepmother (Elsa Lanchester) and stepsisters (Amanda Blake, Lisa Daniels), essentially working as their housekeeper. When the local prince (Michael Wilding) returns from school, a ball is announced. Around that time, Ella meets the prince, who is disguised as the son of the palace chef, and the two fall in love. When she manages to attend the ball, his revealed identity causes quite a stir.

Traveling with little more than her naïveté, sunny teenager Lili (Leslie Caron) arrives in a new town and is befriended by a circus troupe. Though she becomes infatuated with the dashing magician, Marcus the Magnificent (Jean-Pierre Aumont), Lili forms a more significant bond with puppeteer Paul (Mel Ferrer) and his four puppets, which she treats as real people. Together, Lili, Paul and the puppets prove to be a popular act, but their success and happiness are threatened by Paul's gruffness.

Gaston (Louis Jourdan) is a restless Parisian playboy who moves from one mistress to another, while also spending time with Gigi (Leslie Caron), a precocious younger friend learning the ways of high society. The platonic relationship between Gaston and Gigi changes, however, when she matures, but the possibility of something lasting seems unlikely since he won't commit to one woman. Gigi refuses to be anyone's mistress, however, and Gaston must choose between her and his carefree lifestyle.

Jerry Mulligan is an American ex-GI who stays in post-war Paris to become a painter, and falls for the gamine charms of Lise Bouvier. However, his paintings come to the attention of Milo Roberts, a rich American heiress, who is interested in more than just art.

Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family.

En Arizona, un policía y un bombero responden a una grave colisión vehicular. En Florida, la policía persigue a un sospechoso que elige una ruta de escape inesperada, y en Georgia, los oficiales buscan a un hombre armado escondido en el bosque.

Se encuentra metanfetamina escondida dentro de un camión lleno de brócoli congelado. Un hombre es atrapado transportando pastillas dentro de contenedores de proteína en polvo. Un viajero intenta llevar un trofeo de ciervo a través de la frontera.

En Nuevo México, una madre desesperada se aferra a su auto cuando un ladrón lo roba con sus bebés adentro. En Arizona, justo antes del amanecer, un equipo SWAT debe localizar a un individuo visto dentro de una casa de empeños repleta de armas.

El análisis de riesgo selecciona a tres pasajeros y sus historias incoherentes activan una alerta de la Aduana. Los agentes del Ibama localizan a dos viajeras chinas bajo sospecha de transportar artículos prohibidos de la fauna nacional.
Estas son seis de las más duras prisiones del mundo, a tal punto que hasta los jefes de las mafias y asesinos aprenden el significado del miedo.
Los miembros en el cuartel general deben clasificar unánimemente a todos los supervivientes del más fuerte al más débil. Los familiares tienen la oportunidad de escribir una carta a su superviviente.
Una mirada al Paramount Teatro en Asbury Park, Nueva Jersey, cuyo prometedor futuro está amarrado a un trágico pasado.
Una quemadura peligrosa y estrategias de supervivencia atormentan a Ángela y Steven en las selvas de Panamá.

Para la mayoría de la gente, dominar el kung fu Shaolin lleva años. Ed solo tiene unos pocos días para aprender a controlar su Qi, o fuerza vital, antes de enfrentarse a un maestro de artes marciales.

Ed conoce a los hamer, unos ganaderos etíopes que deben saltar una fila de toros para ser considerados hombres. Ed también debe controlar a estos enormes animales y saltar sobre ellos. Es realmente peligroso, sin exagerar.

Gary y Karra intentan sobrevivir en la desolada sabana de Brasil, pero se les acaban los alimentos y los gusanos les hacen pasar un suplicio. Uno de ellos, muerto de hambre, enferma cuando come lo que no debe.

El licenciado Pedro Pulido, compadre y amigo de Martín, quiere una pick-up hot rod hecha a su medida, que se hará partiendo de cero; Pedro no es un cliente común, porque es el abogado de Martín y toda su vida ha padecido de obesidad mórbida.

Luis Carlos Gómez de 67 años y Luz Viviana, de 27 años fueron asesinados de manera violenta el 14 de abril de 2015, en La Dorada, Caldas, en un crimen perpetrado por tres integrantes de una misma familia.

El Zurdo lee en detalle el mensaje que su hija encontró en la botella. El capo de la droga decide rastrear la zona del lago, porque sospecha que la persona secuestrada es la hija de Teresa.
La cita romántica del Zurdo y Teresa se convierte en una batalla campal. Ella queda al descubierto y Oleg queda gravemente herido. El Zurdo pone en riesgo su vida.
El hijo de Martha tiene satiriasis, una enfermedad que provoca un desenfrenado deseo sexual. Milagros sufre histeria femenina y solo se calma con los masajes de su yerno, su hija está molesta.
Su marido muere por un malentendido, exige compensación. En la ceremonia del pañuelo comprueban que la novia no era virgen y se cancela la celebración, lo que provoca una deshonra a la familia.
Susana le pide una compensación a Alex, quien se interpuso en una discusión de pareja y provocó la muerte de su esposo. Geidy quiere divorciarse de Roberto, y que él y su ex desalojen la casa.
Luz América intenta ir al funeral de su hija, pero su hermana y su madre lo impiden. Yarelis cuida a su hijo de 18 años como si fuera un bebé, el padre quiere que el chico se vaya de la casa.

La esposa de Armando está secuestrada por la guerrilla colombiana. Los secuestradores piden hacer un intercambio: exigen que se entregue al hijo de ella con uno de los jefes de la guerrilla y la liberan. Además, Ángel está obsesionado con ser parte de las pruebas de medicamentos que hacen las farmacéuticas. Vive de eso y lo ha sufrido porque perdió su erección en uno de los estudios.
El juez dicta sentencia en el caso de la paternidad de Leonardo, luego pone el ojo en Albieri. Lucas decide ir a Marruecos, Said encuentra primero a Jade. Alí tiene algo que pedirle a Zoraida.
Lucas y Daniel se encuentran en las calles de la medina de Fez, Jade espera por su destino. Albieri huye del suyo, pero cuenta con un compañero incondicional. Alí ve que las piezas encajan.
Liliana secuestra a Daniel tras amenazarlo con matar a Memín y le confiesa su amor, el Diablo se desespera porque no sabe del boliviano. La Diabla negocia cómo infiltrarse en casa de Ponce.
Liliana huye con Daniel para llevarlo a otro escondite, en un forcejeo le dispara y hace lo posible para seducirlo, la policía les sigue la pista. Octavio llega a la casa con su nueva amiga.
En la prueba de fuego, los participantes cocinan un plato inspirado en una cita memorable, donde surgen críticas y se revelan secretos de amor. En la salvación, un trío de tartares sorprende.
Se complica el rescate de Amanda, cuando El Corona aparece y toma a Isabel por el cuello, impidiendo que se lleve a su hija. Diego lo enfrenta a golpes y los tres escapan. Circe se arrepiente.
Tras dejar a Joselito plantado en el altar, Circe amenaza a Eliseo con un arma y le exige que la lleve hasta Diego. No está dispuesta a renunciar a él. Corona levanta una denuncia contra Isabel.
Sofía va sin rumbo por las calles de Culiacán. Lupo quiere encontrarla para protegerla, como un padre a su hija. Pero Kira la descubre y le dispara. Teresa y Jonathan no saben dónde buscar.

Brenda scratches the valuable blues recording her grandfather gave her.
Sandra helps her new roommate (Kim Fields) change into a sexy vamp.
Willis and Arnold soon learn about big business when they start up a brownie-making enterprise.

A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip.
A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower.
A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul.

It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery.

Twenty years after Maria Rossi (Suzan Crowley) murdered three people, her daughter, Isabella (Fernanda Andrade), seeks the truth about that terrible night. Isabella travels to an Italian hospital for the criminally insane -- where Maria is locked away -- to find out whether her mother is mentally ill or demonically possessed. With the help of two young exorcists (Simon Quarterman, Evan Helmuth), Isabella tries to cure Maria -- and engages four demons in a battle for her mother's soul.

Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.
A lawman (Jason Scott Lee) tries to protect a young woman (Kari Wuhrer) who possesses a book that inhabitants of heaven and hell want.

In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.
An undefeated world-champion prizefighter, who is convicted of rape and sent to prison, must confront and fight the reigning prison boxing champion.

A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist.

Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them.

New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.
A rebellious young man runs away from home but returns after experiencing an amazing journey.
The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress.

A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.

After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer (Tim Robbins) struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie (Elizabeth Peña), and ex-wife, Sarah (Patricia Kalember), try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis (Danny Aiello), fails to reach him as he descends into madness.

When an epidemic of a disease known as the "white sickness" appears in her city, the wife (Julianne Moore) of a doctor is one of the few individuals left who still has sight. Sent to a government asylum along with her now-blind husband (Mark Ruffalo), she sees conditions deteriorate until civilization itself is in jeopardy, prompting her break-out of the asylum to lead a small group to freedom.

p.t: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
p.d: After a band of medical students receives a decaying but living body reported to be the vampire Count Dracula (Stephen Billington), they set out to harness his power and immortality. As a bonus, their mentor, Lowell (Craig Sheffer), claims that there is a mysterious donor willing to fund their research. During the study, student Elizabeth Blaine (Diane Neal) injures herself on the vampire's tooth and starts to feel strange. Soon, vampire hunter Father Uffizi (Jason Scott Lee) is on their trail.

p.t: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula III - Legacy
p.d: With help from his partner (Jason Scott Lee), a vampire hunter (Jason London) tries to save his fiancée from the evil count in Romania.
Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies.

Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits.

When the man she loves, Holger Olsen, goes off to fight in the Civil War, Vivienne Le Coudy must fend for herself in a place controlled by a corrupt mayor and his unscrupulous business partner. When Olsen returns from the war, he and Vivienne must confront and make peace with the person each has become.
The Busses battle hail; the Dorrises dodge cave-ins to unearth fluorite; Dwayne's friend brings newbie luck; Amanda must make a tough decision about her future.

Elizabeth y Brice revelan si su bebé es de tamaño promedio o pequeño. Anna y Emma luchan por crear el pastel de pañales perfecto mientras la familia organiza una fiesta para Liz. Trent planea una cita romántica y sin estrés con Amber.

Adam y Danielle viajan a Nashville (Tennessee) y dejan a las quintillizas al cuidado de la familia. Hazel le da a su tío un susto enorme y Adam se da cuenta de que él no es el único que está pasando por un momento complicado.
Zach sigue los pasos de su gemelo y revela que está listo para proponer a su novia, Tori.
Se acerca el día de la boda de Jeremy y Audrey, y cada vez están más nerviosos. Matt se pone enfermo, y todos están preocupados, porque piensan que tal vez no pueda asistir a la ceremonia.

Leyna no soporta ver a Ethan coqueteando con su madre. Kristy intenta mantener la calma cuando se ve obligada a ver a Nancy. Kelly se prepara para conocer a Brittany y Laila va a casa de Shekeb, pero nada sale según lo planeado.

Leyna lucha por mantenerse en pie mientras visita un espacio para la cena de ensayo. Brittany tiene su primera pijamada en casa de Matt. Shekeb le confiesa a Emily que ha almorzado con Yussra. Abbey le dice a Lorenda que se aparte.

La familia se reúne para conocer el sexo del bebé de Zach y Tori. Tanto Matt como Amy experimentan relaciones románticas después del divorcio, mientras que Jeremy y Audrey ponderan dónde establecerse y echar raíces.

Jeremy y Audrey sorprenden a la familia con grandes noticias; para escapar de las renovaciones, Zach y Tori se toman el fin de semana; Amy y Chris enfrentan un potencial problema en su relación; Matt y Caryn equilibran su vida amorosa con el trabajo.

p.d: Un programa basado en el original Extreme Makeover de EE. UU., en donde un equipo de diseñadores reconstruyen y embellecen la casa de gente necesitada en un tiempo muy corto.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.
La mejor información de deportiva de Panamá y el mundo.

Una nueva toma en la serie clásica de 1970 del mismo nombre, trae a tres bellezas frescas para resolver los casos de difícil millonario Charlie Townsend. La princesa de Park Avenue, que se convirtió en ladrón Abby (Rachael Taylor), la desacreditada policía de Miami Kate (Annie Ilonzeh) y la misteriosa corredora de la calle Eva (Minka Kelly) forman una estrecha amistad, ya que tienen una segunda oportunidad en la vida como detectives en la soleada Miami. Aunque son desconocidos cuando se juntan, una cosa es cierta: que siempre se cubrirán las espaldas unas a otras. Drew Barrymore, quien co-protagonizó la película "Los ángeles de Charlie", es la productora ejecutiva de la serie.
Tres miembros de la Brigada de Homicidios de Austria comparten sus labores policiales con Rex, un pastor alemán entrenado como perro policía.

Un teniente de policía se debate entre la fidelidad al cuerpo y la vinculación que mantiene con los amigos junto a los que creció en las calles más duras de Los Ángeles, para quienes, a menudo, la policía es el enemigo.
Los accidentes catastróficos en la historia de la aviación son reproducidos meticulosamente para determinar si estos desastres pudieron haber sido prevenidos.
Danny reopens the investigation into the 2001 killing of the popular owner of a local deli, apparently beaten to death by an employee.
Maggie, OA and the team must stop a hacker who is disabling life-saving equipment in several New York City hospitals; Jubal's son waits for important surgery at one of the impacted hospitals.
The team finds a connection between bombings and a private veterans' club in New York City; Isobel tells a reluctant OA to recruit a former Army buddy for intel.
The team hunts for a serial killer who is targeting young, homeless men; Tiffany and Scola don't see eye to eye on how to handle the case.
After a suburban woman is kidnapped from her home, the team looks into trysts on both sides of a seemingly perfect marriage; OA feels pressure from Mona to make changes in his career path.

The team must track down a shooter targeting detectives from the same precinct and unit while facing mounting tension from the NYPD; Tiffany finds that her NYPD roots may be influencing her view of the situation.

After a young girl is kidnapped from her daycare, the team must help her parents navigate a debt owed to the deadly gang in their neighborhood; Maggie struggles to focus on the case when her sister returns from rehab.

A widow is shocked that her new "boyfriend" is the manipulative leader of a terrorist group planning an attack; Scola is reminded of his brother's death on 9/11; Tiffany worries about his emotional choices during the investigation.

After Rina is critically wounded while heading to work with Jubal, the team makes the chilling discovery that a vengeful Vargas orchestrated the shooting from behind bars and continues to target the rest of their team and their loved ones.
As the team investigates a string of jewelry store robberies that culminate in a double murder, they uncover a connection to a 16-year-old boy trying to survive the foster care system.

Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

Recently divorced mom Lauren (Drew Barrymore) and widowed dad Jim (Adam Sandler) let their friends push them into a blind date, which goes disastrously wrong. Unsurprisingly, neither wants to see the other ever again. However, fate intervenes when both Jim and Lauren, unbeknown to each other, purchase one-half of the same vacation package at a South African resort; they and their children are forced to share the same suite and participate in a slew of family activities together.

Raised by his overprotective mother, Helen, Bobby Boucher Jr. is the water boy for a successful college football team coached by Red Beaulieu. When Beaulieu fires Bobby, he takes up the same position for a losing rival team, led by despairing Coach Klein. After witnessing Bobby beat up a player who teased him too much, Klein adds him to the roster as a linebacker. Soon, Klein's players are championship contenders.
Una mujer vampiro trata de proteger a un estudiante de unos hombres lobo que intentan crear una especie híbrida.
Tras su muerte, Ray Garrison vuelve a la vida gracias a la corporación RST. Ahora, con un ejército de nanotecnología en sus venas, Ray es invencible.
El superperro Krypto se une a un grupo de divertidos y descerebrados animales para que lo ayuden a rescatar a los superhéroes de la Liga de la Justicia, que han sido secuestrados.
El joven Paul lleva una vida aislada debido a su rara hipertricosis congénita, y se escapa de casa el día que cumple 13 años para buscar a la madre que nunca ha conocido.
Mientras huye de mercenarios, un fugitivo termina en un planeta amenazado por un dictador y su violento ejército.
Batman explora la corrupción existente en la ciudad de Gotham y el vínculo de esta con su propia familia. Además, entra en conflicto con un asesino en serie conocido como "el Acertijo".

p.t: La boda de mi mejor amigo
p.d: Julia es una renombrada crítica gastronómica con miedo al compromiso. A pesar de eso, su mejor amigo Manuel y ella se habían prometido que si para cuando cumplieran 35 años seguían solteros, se casarían entre ellos.

Un superhéroe bastante impopular debido a su comportamiento y sus adicciones provoca enormes daños colaterales con cada movimiento que realiza, hasta que recibe ayuda profesional para cambiar su imagen pública.

Under cover of night, vampires engage in an age-old battle with their sworn enemies, the Lycans, a clan of violent werewolves. Selene, a vampire orphaned in the wake of a bloody Lycan attack, works for the vampire clan as a trained killer. When the Lycans take a mysterious interest in Michael Corvin, an exceptional mortal doctor, Selene struggles to save him from Lucian, a ruthless Lycan leader hell-bent on ending the vampire bloodline.
A firefighter does something unexpected after a man that he has been ordered to testify against threatens him.
Interview style program, reporting on world news and entertainment.

A boy runs away from home to find his estranged mother.

Galactic criminal Riddick (Vin Diesel) is on the run, with bounty hunters on his tail. He receives guidance from Aereon (Judi Dench), ambassador from the Elemental race, who informs him that a warrior army known as the Necromongers is annihilating all human life in the galaxy in a bid for universal dominance. The wise Aereon urges Riddick into battle, believing he is the one man who can defeat the Necromongers and their leader, the evil Lord Marshal (Colm Feore).

Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues. As the scale of the perpetrator's plans become clear, he must bring justice to the abuse of power and corruption that plagues the metropolis.
A modern musical version of the classic fairy tale.

A scruffy superhero named Hancock (Will Smith) protects the citizens of Los Angeles but leaves horrendous collateral damage in the wake of every well-intentioned feat. That's OK with Hancock; he doesn't care what people think and is just as likely to be found dozing on a park bench as saving a damsel in distress. However, after saving the life of a PR executive (Jason Bateman) and meeting the man's beautiful wife (Charlize Theron), he realizes that he may have a sensitive side after all.

p.t: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
p.d: Professor Albus Dumbledore knows the powerful, dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald is moving to seize control of the wizarding world. Unable to stop him alone, he entrusts magizoologist Newt Scamander to lead an intrepid team of wizards and witches. They soon encounter an array of old and new beasts as they clash with Grindelwald's growing legion of followers.

Mike O'Donnell (Matthew Perry) was a high-school basketball star with a bright future, but he threw it all away to marry his girlfriend and raise their child. Almost 20 years later, Mike's marriage has failed, his kids think he's a loser, and his job is going nowhere. He gets a chance to correct the mistakes of his past and change his life when he is miraculously transformed into a teenager (Zac Efron), but in trying to fix his past, Mike may be jeopardizing his present and future.

Bryce Johnson, Dr. Mireya Mayor and Russell Acord scour North America in search of the cryptid known as Bigfoot; they return to northern California to explore compelling evidence and unlock this centuries-old mystery.

Deep in the Northern California wilderness, Russell stops at nothing to reach a nesting site; Mireya and Bryce uncover evidence that a family of Bigfoot is nearby; Ben speaks with a witness who had a chilling encounter with Bigfoot.

Deep in Northern California's lost coast, an audio expert joins the fold after the team hears unusual sounds; Russell must take shelter from a storm; Bryce speaks with a local Hoopa Tribal Council member after reviewing illuminating footage.

Russell searches a rugged hillside full of caves in Northern California's forests; Bryce speaks with a witness who hears frightening grunts; Mireya and Tobe Johnson expand their search area to determine if Bigfoot is mimicking animal sounds.

Russell discovers new sights and sounds deep in the backcountry of Northern California; Bryce talks with a witness who had an experience with a family of Bigfoot; Mireya reaches new heights in search of physical evidence of the elusive creature.

In NorCal's backcountry, the team develops a clear plan of attack to lure Bigfoot out of hiding; Russell travels overnight, hoping to gather key evidence in their search; Mireya and Bryce conduct an investigation unlike any other.

The team's investigations converge as Bryce, Mireya and Russell discover tree structures on different sides of the same mountain; as a storm approaches, Bryce prepares an AI-powered surveillance array that will help pinpoint Bigfoot's location.

Bryce, Mireya and Russell converge at the center of their NorCal hot zone as a catastrophic storm threatens the expedition; armed with AI technology, they're ready to meet the elusive cryptid before it's too late; Russell spies signs of Bigfoot.

Months after the Northern California expedition, Bryce, Mireya, and Russell head to Washington after a fresh lead points to a target zone where Bigfoot groups are congregating for an unknown reason; Survivalist Biko Wright joins the hunt.

South of a Bigfoot chokepoint in Washington, Russell follows a trail of warning signs into the backcountry; Mireya and Biko track what could be a curious Bigfoot; Bryce speaks with a witness, who wishes he never laid eyes on the cryptid creature.

In the heart of The Fork, Russell is on the trail of a possible pair of Bigfoot; Mireya and Biko utilize cutting-edge tech to try and catch a base camp intruder as Bryce makes a startling find while reviewing footage.

The Jokers can't contain the laughs as they answer survey questions for a new snack food and present the world's worst pharmaceutical ads; the loser will work up a sweat in a punishment that's all pain, no gain.

Attention shoppers; the Jokers make mischief by taking unflattering pictures of grocery store patrons, then posing as horrible employees at the Yeti store; tonight's loser must meet his fate in a punishment.

The Jokers play unprofessional actors in a fake commercial then make wild assumptions about other mall goers; one Joker breaks and is tasked with becoming the strictest security guard imaginable in his punishment.

The Jokers pretend to be medical students in training with standardized patient actors, then play the hero and break up a public fight, hoping to earn applause; one Joker has to put his hips where his mouth is and settle a bet of his own making.
The jokers are asking strangers to send an important text to their loved ones and hunting for their missing kid using crazy descriptions.

The Jokers hatch horrible revenge schemes on their office bullies, then put one poor contractor through the wringer as they attempt home improvement projects; tonight's loser will be gifted the world's finest douchemobile.

The Jokers are back as wacky inventors pitching a whole new line of AI-themed gadgets; they fill out bogus incident reports with unsuspecting deli customers; the loser will be forced to demonstrate mentally absurd and physically grueling apps.

The Jokers pretend to be bellhops and need to do and say what they're told while assisting unsuspecting guests to their rooms. Then, the guys need to give away tickets to an absurd made-up show they can no longer see.
The Jokers' mothers visit as overprotective parents meeting a Joker's girlfriend; a Joker must convince a stranger to pose as his girlfriend for a Broadway outing with his mother.

The Jokers are back playing lawyers, trying to convince unsuspecting focus group participants to sign off on ridiculous terms and conditions before they go in. Then they put their family businesses to the test by asking strangers if their radio ad is good to stay on the air. Later, one joker will be getting revenge in an elaborate punishment that the other two are really going to feel.

The Jokers are hitting the floor as restaurant owners of a New York Pizzeria, forced to say and do whatever wacky things the other guys tell them to. Later, they're back at Tompkins Square bagels trying to hunt down a customer that left a scathing review. Then, the losing joker is in for a punishment that really sucks.

The Jokers are back at Colonial Diner, offering some new bizarre specials to unsuspecting patrons; they take a ride through the park; after a nasty fall, the Joker must get park goers to help them out from underneath their bike.

The Jokers are unsympathetic store managers, forced to throw out a disruptive customer before dealing with the wrath and disdain of fellow patrons; thus the guys must get a bystander to take their side during a heated argument with their fake spouses.

p.t: Canals: The Making of a Nation
p.d: Liz McIvor discovers how carving up the landscape in order to build canals helped further our understanding of the earth below.

p.t: Pubs, Ponds, and Power: The Story of the Village
p.d: The village of Milton Abbas in Dorset perfectly captures the romantic notion of the idyllic English village, but as archaeologist Ben Robinson reveals, behind it lurks a history of one man's wealth and power. With help from local historians, Ben learns how the local landowner in the 18th century destroyed a nearby town, uprooting its residents, because it ruined the view from his house. The landscape was transformed, and a new village was built as part of his showpiece estate.

Using 50 years of BBC History archive film, Dr Alice Roberts investigates how views and understanding of Roman Britain have changed over the decades. Along the way she investigates a diverse range of subjects from the Roman invasion, through Hadrian's Wall, the Vindolanda tablets and the eventual collapse of Roman rule.
A child from the Mumbai slums is accused of fraud after victory in India's 'Who Wants to be a Millionaire?'.
A. R. Rahman chats to Haroon Rashid about his 30+ year career producing music for some of India's most iconic films, international successes, AI and working with Hans Zimmer.

Aminatta Forna tells the story of legendary Timbuktu and its long hidden legacy of hundreds of thousands of ancient manuscripts. With its university founded around the same time as Oxford, Timbuktu is proof that the reading and writing of books have long been as important to Africans as to Europeans.

The sewers take to their marks for Sports Week as host Sara Pascoe sets three new challenges. Patrick and Esme's Pattern Challenge is a Sewing Bee first: a pair of high-top trainers. Sewing bespoke footwear means tackling a range of unfamiliar techniques, including punching eyelets and stitching soles - all of which must be done twice to create a perfect pair.

A large part of the remote, blue wilderness of the South Pacific is a marine desert. Many animals that live in the ocean, among them sharks, whales and turtles, must go to extraordinary lengths to survive. Tiger sharks travel hundreds of miles to feast on fledgling albatross chicks and, every year, sperm whales journey from one side of the South Pacific to the other in their search for food and mates.

`Flog It!' comes from Sandon Hall in Staffordshire. Experts Christina Trevanion and David Fletcher choose items to take to auction, including a large collection of boxed Corgi toys and some rare watches. Presenter Paul Martin discovers the dramatic political life of one of Sandon's earlier owners, the 1st Earl of Harrowby, a member of William Pitt's cabinet, including a period as foreign secretary during the Napoleonic Wars.

When the guys visit a woman overwhelmed by an inheritance, she opens a secret vault. They meet their match in an 80-year-old who speeds a mini bike around his property.
Channel 4's midday news summary.

p.d: In Maidenhead, Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien meet Val Lindsay, whose family have raced cars for generations. Simon falls in love with an old ship's carpenter's chest, which he wants to gently restore, while Henry takes away a miniature Tether car.

Steph and John are paired up to transform a 1950s semi in Southport into a modern family home. But the house is a clever cornucopia of nautically-themed hidey-holes, including a vintage ship's wheel that opens a pulley system to get into the attic.
Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Neil Delamere in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.

Karl and Sonia from North Yorkshire are making a permanent move to the Charente-Maritime region of France. For their budget of £160,000, they want a three-bed property, a kitchen for baking, a barn, and spectacular views.
Keri and Carolyn bring essential infrastructure to their Italian borgo. In France, Dan throws open his château's doors to the public. And can Mike recover after storms batter his village?

Sarah and Paul hope their cosy pods will turn all of the B&Bers into happy campers at their 3Trees Glamping in Derbyshire. A spider sighting sends some scurrying - but that's not as scary as the additional cleaning fee.

On the penultimate night, cabaret practitioner Vanessa is turning her modest semi into a Chicago speakeasy, with home comfort food, illicit hooch and some burlesque bravado. Her piña colada crumble amazes, and the group learn the art of face yoga.

p.t: Body of Evidence: A Teagarden Mystery
p.d: Young Aurora Teagarden returns home to Lawrenceton to pursue her post-graduate degree but soon finds herself embroiled in a mystery involving her friend's fiancé.
When an axe-wielding, escaped psychiatric inmate drops dead in Castle's P.I. office, Castle and Beckett's investigation leads Castle to suspect the victim's death could be the work of the Antichrist.
The felling and fate of the Sycamore Gap tree caused sorrow among the public. But this film shows some of the inspiring responses to the loss of the century-old landmark.
Join Dan Walker and the team for the news that matters to you.

p.t: The Big Steam Adventure: Here We Go Again!
p.d: The intrepid trio continue their journey. They begin with a 21-foot steam launch called Bruin, get to grips with a 1908 Stanley steam car as their second vehicle, and eventually make their way to the North Yorkshire Moors Railway.
Steve Backshall reveals that bee stings are nothing to be afraid of as he wears a 'bee beard', allowing 10,000 to crawl all over his face. Plus, a look at the dreaded Asian hornet!
Peter Wright's friend Bernie Slaven brings in Irish setter Cara who has developed a worrying growth on her lip. Rohin Aojula helps a cow that's become extremely wobbly on her feet.

Helen welcomes the new Friesian cows to Heston, hoping an increased milk yield will be good for business. Mrs Hall joins forces with Mrs Pumphrey at the Women's Institute and has an idea. And Tristan makes the most of an amenable Siegfried.
Four children died in ward 4 at Grantham Hospital in early 1991. The doctors and police gathered the evidence to convict the killer nurse, Beverley Allitt.
A dream holiday ends in tragedy when a young British woman travelling to New Zealand is lured into what appears to be an innocent date by a violent online predator.
A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.
Which late 2010s tracks have since racked up over a billion streams worldwide? Think Kygo, DJ Snake, Marshmello and Major Lazer in the mix!
Exploring the heavy hits, vocal anthems, dirty beats and bangin' basslines. This is the 2010s at its finest!

Lois ist nicht von dem neuen Whirlpool begeistert, den Hal hinter ihrem Rücken gekauft hat. Nach kurzer Zeit schon sammeln sich Algen im Becken und Hal steigt demonstrativ in den Pool und trägt schlimme Hautverätzungen davon.

Lois' Mutter Ida taucht aus dem Nichts auf und kündigt der Familie an, dass sie am nächsten Tag heiraten wird. Der Bräutigam Mr. Li will Ida mit nach Hongkong nehmen. Malcolm findet heraus, dass Ida alle unter Drogen gesetzt hat.

Jay verwendet im Restaurant ein altes Saucenrezept, das er von Pete erhalten hat - allerdings verärgert er damit einen rivalisierenden Restaurantbesitzer. Daher müssen die Geister kreativ werden, um die Lage entschärfen zu können.

Hugo taucht auf einer Steuersünder-CD auf und will von der Bildfläche verschwinden. Da hat er sich gedacht, einfach seinen Selbstmord vorzutäuschen, und Bastian soll ihm dabei helfen. Das kann allerdings nur schiefgehen.
Bei Moderatorin Desi Lydic ist der Musiker Tom Morello zu Gast. Er präsentiert sein neues Album.

Hayley beschließt, nach Frankreich auszuwandern, was Stan dazu veranlasst, Gott und die Welt in Bewegung zu versetzen, um sie an Ort und Stelle zu halten. Dabei schreckt er auch nicht davor zurück, Hayley zu beichten, dass sie als kleines Kind von der CIA einer Gehirnwäsche unterzogen wurde.

Francine möchte so wie in alten Zeiten mit der Familie in den Mittelalter-Freizeitpark "Familyland" fahren. Dort angekommen wird versehentlich der tiefgefrorene, böse Gründer des Parks, Roy Family, aufgetaut.
Bender und die Crew reisen nach Westen, um sich dem Bitcoin-Mining-Ansturm anzuschließen.
Als Nibbler krank wird, schrumpft die Crew, um sich auf eine gefährliche Mission in der Wüstenwelt zu begeben, die sich innerhalb seines Katzenklos befindet.

Tina arbeitet in einem Altersheim, um sich das Thunder-Girls-Abzeichen zu verdienen. Unter den alten Menschen werden ihre Vorstellungen von Liebe und Romantik auf den Kopf gestellt. Bob gewinnt unterdessen neue Freunde, die ihn verändern.

Der Klebekrieg der Kinder überschneidet sich zeitlich mit einem wichtigen Termin von Bob. Er soll nämlich von einem Journalisten für einen Artikel über unbekannte Restaurants interviewt werden. Die Situation gerät schon bald aus dem Ruder.
Jimmy und Timmy könnten den ersten Preis beim jährlichen Wissenschaftsfest gewinnen.
PC Principal sieht sich mit Komplikationen im Umgang mit der neuen Vizerektorin konfrontiert.

Stan möchte, dass Steve in der Schule endlich populärer wird. Dazu verabreicht er ihm Hormone, die ihn größer und stärker machen sollen. Der Plan geht etwas anders als erwartet auf: Nebenwirkungen der Hormone sorgen dafür, dass Steve ganz besonders auffällt.
Steve zeigt überhaupt kein Interesse an dem Job von Stan. Daher will Stan ihn austauschen.

At a party, Ray and Debra do a dead-on impersonation of Frank and Marie that brings down the house. But when Frank and Marie turn the tables and do a Ray and Debra imitation, they don't find it funny at all.
When Debra stumbles across a cassette tape that contains a message from Ray's college girlfriend, she wants to know why he has saved it all of these years.
Ray is ready to speak with Ally about the facts of life, only to find that Ally's interest has changed from where babies come from to the meaning of life.
Debra decides to run for school president. Ray isn't sure he can handle the twins by himself during all those meetings so he votes against her.
Sabrina agrees to be fixed up by Zelda with a handsome and charming witch Derek, but he turns out to be prejudiced because she is half-mortal.
When Sabrina receives a 'C' on an assignment, Zelda holds a private tutorial with Sabrina's handsome professor.
Sabrina (Melissa Joan Hart) decides to celebrate a conventional Christmas with Morgan's (Elisa Donovan) ostensibly perfect family. With Beth Broderick and Caroline Rhea.
When Josh sells his first photo with Sabrina's help, he gets a swelled head and quits his job at the coffeehouse.

Ross comes back from China with his new girlfriend Julie, and Rachel has a really hard time dealing with it. She winds up sleeping with Paolo and hates herself for it. Joey persuades her to tell Ross how she feels, but when Ross tells her he is in love with Julie, she can't bring herself to do it.

While Carol and Susan are away, Ross and the friends babysit his newborn son Ben, but Ross is disgusted when Phoebe tests the temperature of some bottled breast milk on her wrist. Meanwhile, Joey competes with a fellow cologne salesman.
When downstairs neighbour Mr Heckles dies, the friends clean out his flat, but Chandler becomes convinced his hyper-critical nature will mean he ends up alone and sad, just like Heckles.

Everyone is surprised when Phoebe's husband, a gay Canadian ice dancer, shows up, as nobody knew she was married. Elsewhere, Chandler reveals his third nipple, and Ross's new relationship is under attack, unbeknown to him.

Monica gets promoted and invites the friends out for dinner to celebrate, but problems arise when the difference in their salaries becomes apparent and the group splits in two. Meanwhile, when Chandler sets a woman up to get a date with her, a case of mistaken identities means that he discovers what she really thought of him.
Joey and Chandler babysit Ben who turns out to be a babe magnet until they accidentally leave him on a bus. Meanwhile, Phoebe loses her job as the singer at Central Perk to Stephanie.

Ross and Julie announce they are getting a cat together, while Rachel gets drunk on a date and all she talks about is Ross. She decides to get closure by calling him and telling his machine she is over him. Meanwhile, Chandler regrets asking Monica to help him lose weight.
Videotape that appears to show Mike leaving the mayor in the line of gunfire damages their relationship.
Mike and Nikki struggle with taking their relationship to the next level, and the Mayor and the staff participate in a stakeout.
Rachel forces Ross to terminate their marriage, Phoebe's first triplet babysitting experience proves stressful, and Joey pretends to own a German sports car.
It's the last night before Chandler moves into Monica's apartment, leaving Joey alone and prompting Rachel to make plans to move in with Phoebe.
Ross overdoses on tooth whitener before a date, Phoebe tells Rachel that she kissed Ralph Lauren at Rachel's workplace, and Joey's new roommate wants to redecorate.

On Thanksgiving, Chandler tries to gain favour with Monica's parents Jack and Judy, but an old secret involving Ross causes problems that he is unaware of. Meanwhile, Rachel proves she is no domestic goddess when she creates a quite disastrous dessert.
Today's caseload includes felonious farmers, daring escapes, and package pilfering.
A cacophony of crime featuring sinful Santas, bad bears, and a jailbird on a jet ski.
The guys Greek out while lending a hand at a restaurant and then compete head-to-head answering questions in a focus group. The loser is forced to spend a day locked in a den at the zoo.
The guys play the laugh man standing challenge, and then try to get strangers to repeat the strange backstory of the Gatto dogs.
Robert is ecstatic when he is recommended for the FBI job until it becomes apparent that Marie's intrusive ways may be his undoing.

A convicted murderer denies masturbating during a psychological evaluation. A judge has no time for Sovereign Citizen tactics. A defendant drops the F-bomb in bond court.
In 2012, Mick and Mairead Philpott were charged with the murders of six children that died in a house fire.
Bludgeoned to death while walking down a country lane, the horrific murders of Lin and Megan Russell make worldwide news.
In 1989, 51 lives were lost when the pleasure boat Marchioness collided with dredger Bowbelle and sank.

A young immigrant mother is killed in a hunting accident while out with her fiancé. As police investigate, they unravel a tangle of romantic relationships, money and motives to reveal the terrifying truth of what really happened.

An affluent family at war with each other for over a decade find themselves at the centre of a murder investigation when a beloved uncle is found dead. Police unravel a conspiracy involving a wayward son and a counterfeit secret agent.

When a young mother, her daughter and a friend vanish after a visit with extended family, those close to the victims suspect foul play. Without proof, the mystery deepens until a member of one of the feuding families makes a shocking admission.

A gruesome Thanksgiving triple murder case lays bare a family's violent past, including a son and daughter each with a score to settle. As the years pass and the case goes unsolved, three families desperately fight for the truth and justice.
Lt. Joe Kenda must comb through unreliable testimony from teenage witnesses when investigating the shooting death of a 14-year-old student stemming from a heated canteen confrontation.
A young man who came to the US to fulfil his dreams is killed at a birthday party. Tulsa police must cut through a web of lies to find the culprit.

A young immigrant mother is killed in a hunting accident while out with her fiancé. As police investigate, they unravel a tangle of romantic relationships, money and motives to reveal the terrifying truth of what really happened.
Three cases from The First 48 that went cold, frustrating detectives.
When officers conduct a routine welfare check on a disabled man and his elderly mother in Racine, Wisconsin, they uncover a shocking scene inside the home.
In New York, Maria turns part of her home into a flat for her grandson, but everything unravels when a negligent tenant living under the same roof as her refuses to vacate.
Customs officers come across a suspicious boat, far out at sea at night. They believe that the boat is part of a smuggling operation that is helping the criminals to refuel their speedboats.

p.t: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
p.d: In the Byzantine city of Ravenna Rick discovers piadinas, street food dating back to Roman times. He then crosses the Adriatic Sea to Croatia and takes the opportunity to discover new dishes like pasticada, goat stew with peas and lamb peka.

p.t: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
p.d: Rick Stein travels through Croatia and savours the famous oysters of Ston. He then crosses the border to Albania, a country loved by Lord Byron. Rick and his son move through a land that time forgot, visiting shepherds in remote mountain expanses.

The team find out if it is possible to get a reliable used car for less than £500, with the help of a tank assault course. Chris lives the high life in Maserati's new MC20 supercar, while Freddie goes on the charge in the all-electric Rivian pick-up truck.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy celebrate 100 years of the BBC by tackling motorsport 1920s-style. Paddy also delves into the history of BMW's legendary M-cars, Chris gets to grips with Ford's new WRC racer, and the team investigate the future of fuel.

Paul, Bob and Ted travel a short distance to Thornwood Springs Fishery in Essex, a complex of three lakes on the edges of Epping Forest, in search of a big rudd - although there's also the chance of a trout in the waters.

p.t: James May's Cars of the People
p.d: From the Rolls-Royce that became a people's champion to the blue-collar heroes that launched a thousand burn-ups, James reveals how aspiration and new wealth would drive the development of some of the greatest cars ever made.
Dave and Si find out who ate all the pies on the football pitch and discover the history behind some of the nation's most iconic pies.

Paul and Bob travel to Dorset to fish the River Frome in search of grayling. As the pair fish along this unspoilt stretch of river, they realise grayling are not the only species roaming these waters. They attempt mackerel fishing on Chesil Beach.
Rob Brydon is joined by team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Josh Widdicombe, Gemma Cairney, Raj Bisram and Sophie Hermann.
Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Bob Mortimer, Samantha Morton, Miles Jupp and Sarah Hadland.

Extended episode of the popular quiz show in which contestants are rewarded more if their answers are 'quite interesting'. Stephen Fry asks panellists Alan Davies, Sue Perkins, Bill Bailey and Gyles Brandreth, unanswerable questions about parts of the body beginning with the letter H.

p.t: Have I Got a Bit More News for You
p.d: Harry Hill is guest host, with panellists comedian Jack Dee and journalist Zing Tsjeng joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop as they delve into the news.

Jared gambles half of his crew on a long-abandoned claim loaded with big wood, chasing a royalty-free windfall. This risky move to raise $1M in just eight weeks could win Cypress Creek the Forever Claim - or sink everything.
A couple build a sustainable straw bale panel house in the Hudson Valley - the first of this type in America. They need to finish it before winter hits.

Mark Smith builds an off-grid modular home perched high on a cliff off the coast of Vancouver, Canada; the pressure is on as even the smallest mistake can result in the home tumbling 85 feet down into the ocean.
The staff hopes for a mating match between the black rhino newcomers, Kendi and Aria; the zoo cares for an abandoned beaded lizard found in a local yard; the meerkat mob is put on a new furry diet.

Plans are made for tufted deer Poppy and Honeysuckle to meet Draco, a potential mate known for his "fangs;" brother grizzlies prep for a new diet; a century-old Galápagos tortoise Abigail undergoes a critical surgery.
Nicole and Bruce leave the Lower 48 for a new life up north. They have a private plane, so can buy a house anywhere - as long the house has its own runway.
Tiffany and Roland live in Anchorage, Alaska's biggest city, but hectic city life is too much for their family. Instead, they search for a home in the wilderness.
Wes and Angela own an air taxi company in Alaska. They're looking for a million dollar dream home, and can fly anywhere in the state to find it.
Ron and Lacey have a big truck and a small budget for their new home. They're willing to sacrifice space for the truck to be right on a lake near Big Lake.

Homesteading has exploded in popularity, with families moving to more remote areas and with bigger ambition than ever before. But for the rookie off-gridder striving for self-sufficiency, extreme plans often lead to extreme problems.

The Volvo Amazon 122 is a classic Swedish auto with true rally heritage. Mike travels to the Pacific Northwest, where he has tracked down a true barn find. Ant is tasked to make it roadworthy before the boys know the true scope of the work ahead.
Mike gets his hands dirty preparing the Bronco for the biggest collector car auction in the world, Barrett Jackson.

Emergency flares light the sky as 12 all-stars scramble to grab supplies and dive into the dark Philippine Sea. A venomous jellyfish sting puts one survivalist in severe pain, jeopardising their challenge.

Drew and Tee travel to four extraordinary locations across Northern Italy, including the country's most famed antique markets and a dreamy Tuscan villa.

p.d: The guys make a trap for fly-tippers and give Wiltshire its own dartboard. Plus, James invents 'The Herb Hat' for when food needs an extra flourish.

Mike takes the plunge and invests in a car and a boat, all in one. However, it has some underlying problems that could quite easily make their profits sink like a stone.
Henry and Fuzz motor over to Taff's place in Lincoln. His extensive collection of Easy Rider-style chopper motorbikes includes an engraved 1970s Yamaha.
Henry and Fuzz view an exquisite collection of military and civilian vehicles in Guildford. What will they sell to the drummer from a British rock band?
